properties.displayName: Bower Security Operations and Pipeline Health

properties.description: Bower - Late events beyond detection tolerance (14-day hunt) Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: Bower - Late events beyond detection tolerance (14-day hunt)
properties.query:
// Hunting: every event the beyond-tolerance monitor should have reported in the last 14 days.
// Align maxDelay with maxIngestionDelayMinutes from deploy/sentinel/analytics/main.bicep.
let maxDelay = 360m;
BowerSecurityEvents
| where BowerFirstIngested > ago(14d)
| where BowerFirstIngested - BowerEventTime > maxDelay or BowerTimeRewritten
| summarize
    LateEvents = count(),
    RewrittenTimes = countif(BowerTimeRewritten),
    OldestEvent = min(BowerEventTime),
    MaxDeliveryDelay = max(BowerFirstIngested - BowerEventTime),
    EventTypes = make_set(EventType, 20)
    by CollectorId, Slot = bin(BowerFirstIngested, 1h)
| order by Slot asc, CollectorId asc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Lists every Bower security event in the last 14 days that first arrived more than 360 minutes
after its event time or whose TimeGenerated Azure Monitor rewrote. Compare each hourly slot
against the beyond-tolerance analytics rule alerts to detect skipped monitoring runs and
events that require manual hunting after an outage.

properties.displayName: Bower - Late events beyond detection tolerance (14-day hunt)

properties.description: Bower - Delivery reconciliation (queued vs arrived events) Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: Bower - Delivery reconciliation (queued vs arrived events)

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Compares events queued by each Bower collector (sum of pipeline.eventsQueued from
collector_health records) against distinct EventId values ingested into BowerSecurity_CL.
Designed for outputs that cannot confirm destination arrival, such as BOWER_OUTPUT=ama-syslog.

properties.displayName: Bower - Delivery reconciliation (queued vs arrived events)

properties.description: Bower - Collector health sequence gaps (post-delivery loss detection) Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: Bower - Collector health sequence gaps (post-delivery loss detection)

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Detects missing collector_health sequence numbers within each collector run (collectorStartedAt).
A gap indicates that a health record queued by Bower never reached BowerSecurity_CL, signalling
potential event loss in unacknowledged paths such as BOWER_OUTPUT=ama-syslog.

properties.displayName: Bower - Collector health sequence gaps (post-delivery loss detection)

properties.description: Bower - Replay and duplicate delivery summary Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: Bower - Replay and duplicate delivery summary
properties.query:
// Exact event count versus raw row count per collector (avoids dcount() estimation error).
BowerSecurityEvents
| where BowerEventTime > ago(7d)
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    Rows = sum(BowerCopies),
    ReplayedEvents = countif(BowerCopies > 1),
    ExtraRows = sum(BowerCopies - 1),
    MaxCopies = max(BowerCopies),
    RewrittenTimes = countif(BowerTimeRewritten)
    by CollectorId
| order by ExtraRows desc, CollectorId asc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Counts exact distinct Bower security events against raw rows in BowerSecurity_CL per collector,
highlighting at-least-once delivery replays and extra rows collapsed by BowerSecurityEvents.

properties.displayName: Bower - Replay and duplicate delivery summary

properties.description: Bower - High-risk sensitive data and secret redaction findings Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: Bower - High-risk sensitive data and secret redaction findings
properties.query:
// High-risk privacy and secret redaction alerts (metadata only; original values are never persisted).
BowerSecurityEvents
| where BowerEventTime > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "sensitive_data_detected"
| project
    BowerEventTime,
    ApplicationName,
    ApplicationEnvironment,
    EventSeverity,
    ActorUserId,
    SourceIpAddress,
    CollectorId,
    CorrelationId,
    PrivacyDetected
| order by BowerEventTime desc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Hunts for sensitive_data_detected events emitted by Bower's Privacy & Secret Protection Engine
when regulated Australian identifiers (TFN, Medicare, IHI, ABN/ACN), payment cards, credentials
or cryptographic material are detected and redacted before persistence. Only metadata is
recorded; original sensitive values are never stored or forwarded.

properties.displayName: Bower - High-risk sensitive data and secret redaction findings

properties.description: Bower - Sentinel rule health and alert visibility latency Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: Bower - Sentinel rule health and alert visibility latency
properties.query:
// Failed Bower analytics rule executions from SentinelHealth (drop ingestion_time filter for ad-hoc hunts).
SentinelHealth
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where SentinelResourceType == "Analytics Rule" and SentinelResourceName startswith "Bower"
| where Status != "Success"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    SentinelResourceName,
    Status,
    Reason,
    Issue = tostring(ExtendedProperties.Issues[0].Code),
    WindowEnd = todatetime(ExtendedProperties.QueryEndTimeUTC)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Checks failed Bower analytics rule executions in SentinelHealth and measures SecurityAlert
queryability lag against the alert-visibility budget assumed by replay-safe catch-up slots.
Requires Sentinel auditing and health monitoring to be enabled on the workspace.

properties.displayName: Bower - Sentinel rule health and alert visibility latency

properties.description: Bower: Windows failed network logons from one address (replay-safe) Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

At least 10 distinct Windows 4625 network logon failures from one source address in a
10-minute event-time bucket. Replayed Bower rows are collapsed by BowerSecurityEventsOfType
and late events are evaluated once, at first ingestion, up to 360 minutes late.

properties.descriptionHtml:
The [Bower](https://github.com/jusso-dev/Bower) solution for Microsoft Sentinel packages replay-safe KQL parsers (`BowerSecurityEvents` and `BowerSecurityEventsOfType`), scheduled analytics rules (Windows Event Collector brute force, firewall denial bursts, beyond-tolerance late-arrival monitoring, OWASP ASVS application security detections, and collector/source health), threat-hunting and reconciliation queries, and an operations workbook for `BowerSecurity_CL`.

All analytics rules are installed as templates and start disabled so operators can validate them against live workspace telemetry before enabling.

**Data Connectors:** 1, **Parsers:** 2, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 10, **Hunting Queries:** 6
